candidates.description: This vector represents terms denoting high magnitude, extent, frequency, or degree.
This feature vector represents religious and cultural traditions, practices, and spirituality.
This feature vector represents general nouns describing structural elements, relationships, or domains of human and legal organization.
This vector activates on words and terms related to historical empires, classical antiquity, and ancient languages.
These tokens represent past tense verbs indicating actions, establishments, or events that have already occurred.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to numerical strings representing three-digit numbers, particularly area codes or postal codes.
These tokens represent discourse markers, conjunctions, and transitional adverbs across multiple European languages.
These tokens represent indefinite quantifiers and determiners indicating amount or plurality across multiple European languages.
These tokens represent additive or emphatic connectors and adverbial modifiers used across multiple languages to express inclusion, degree, or continuation.
This vector represents common French grammatical words, articles, and prepositions.
